name: llm-runner
description: LLM runner interface for prompterator. Reads a user prompt from stdin and writes the LLM response to stdout.
command-line: llm-runner [--system SYSTEM] [--temperature TEMPERATURE] [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS] [--model MODEL] [--endpoint ENDPOINT] [--api-version API_VERSION] [--descriptor]

inputs.name: System prompt
inputs.description: System prompt to prepend to the conversation.

inputs.name: Max tokens
inputs.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate.

inputs.name: API version
inputs.description: API version string (used by Azure OpenAI).

inputs.name: Descriptor
inputs.description: Print the Boutiques descriptor JSON and exit.

output-files.name: LLM response
output-files.description: LLM response text written to stdout (or JSON descriptor when --descriptor is used).

error-codes.description: Error (missing API key, invalid input, API failure, etc.).

prompterator.stdout: LLM response text (plain) or Boutiques JSON (with --descriptor)
